note: Single-column body page carrying two stacked worked-example panels (Example 1.8 and Example 1.9). Per instruction each panel is measured as three distinct elements: the grey panel fill (#d9d9d9, sampled from flat interior well away from glyphs and edges), the cyan vertical side tab in the left margin bearing the rotated 'EXAMPLE 1.8' / 'EXAMPLE 1.9' label (#29abe2), and the narrow cyan rule closing the panel's right edge (#29abe2). The side tabs are given role marginal_note because they are text-bearing labels set in the margin; the right-edge cyan rules are given role box because they are plain filled rectangles and the rule_bar / page_header_band / footer_rule roles are reserved for the horizontal band types defined in the brief. Block n values were matched strictly by position against the re-blocked list in the input: n=1 and n=3 are the two equation stacks in the upper panel (n=3 covers the whole a_p stack through '= 1.9 x 10^12 m s^-2' as one block), n=6 is the Fig. 1.14 diagram, and n=8 and n=10 are the two equations in the lower panel. Every one of the 11 blocks matched a position confidently; no nulls were needed for matching. Elements A2 never blocked and so carry n: null are the light blue top band with its cyan rules, the grey 'Physics' title bar, the small two-square decorative icon inside it, the two cyan side tabs, the two cyan right-edge rules, the 'FIGURE 1.14' caption (no caption block exists in the input), the grey page-number box, and the '2022-23' line at the page foot. The footer line is given role running_header as the nearest allowed value for a running footer; it is not a coloured footer_rule. The grey title bar at the top overlaps the light blue header band, whose bbox is reported at full page width as printed behind it. body_text_size_px measured as the cap-to-baseline height of the justified body prose in block n=2.
